method: shared Stage-0 ERM ResNet-50 backbone and linear classifier (evaluated on raw embeddings)

implementation.repository: src/models/resnet.py (compatible with baselines/dpe4subpop Stage-0 ERM sequential ResNet-50)

artifacts.format: pytorch_state_dict_weights_only (0.* ResNet-50 backbone keys + 2.weight/2.bias linear classifier keys)

preprocessing: Forward through ResNet-50 trunk + Flatten to raw 2048-D embedding (no row standardization applied for ERM linear head)

inference.evaluation_mode: model.eval() with torch.inference_mode(), raw 2048-D features passed to Linear(2048, 2) head
inference.decision_rule: argmax over [p(landbird), p(waterbird)]; equal probabilities select index 0 (landbird)

selection.procedure: Fixed final-step checkpoint (ckpt_last.pt at epoch 100 of Stage-0 ERM backbone training)
selection.selection_data: None (fixed final epoch per upstream DPE Stage-0 protocol)

verification.scope: Verified exact numerical identity between sequential image-to-logits forward pass and raw-feature linear head evaluation on the validation and test splits (max probability difference 0.0; 100% label agreement).

limitations: checkpoints/dpe_ckpt_last.zip is a bare PyTorch state_dict without embedded training config metadata. Its empirical test accuracy (92.35% raw, 76.64% WGA) aligns closely with the 100-epoch augmented ERM* Stage-0 checkpoint rather than the unaugmented --no_augmentation Stage-0 run (62.46% WGA), while using the canonical experiment directory ID erm_stage0_seed0 from docs/export_predictions.md.
